clauses.R1: Refunds of £50.00 or less for an allowed reason (damaged, not delivered, wrong item, duplicate charge) on an order placed within the last 30 days may be issued automatically.
clauses.R2: Refunds above £50.00 and up to £500.00 require approval from a human on the finance team before money moves.
clauses.R3: Refunds above £500.00 are never issued by the agent and must be routed to the finance lead.
clauses.R4: Orders placed more than 30 days ago are not eligible for a refund.
clauses.R5: A customer may receive at most 1 refund in any 30-day period; further requests require human approval (fraud guard).
clauses.R6: A refund may never exceed the amount still refundable on the original payment.
clauses.R7: The requester's email must match the email on the original payment; otherwise the request is denied.
clauses.R8: The agent may auto-refund at most £150.00 in total per day; requests beyond this budget require human approval.
clauses.R9: Reasons outside the allowed list (e.g. changed mind) are denied automatically.
clauses.R10: If no payment matching the order can be found, the request is denied and no money moves.
